[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-ft[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Blocked-reason marks — every [?] checkbox says why[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Obsidian, a Blocked task's checkbox shows why it is blocked. It [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shows & for its own open prerequisite, ^ for a blocked project, 1–4[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for a P1–P4 priority deferral, ⟲ for a recurring rule's next run, ?[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for a date picked by hand, and a dashed ? when no reason is left. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Solid boxes mean held by other work, hollow boxes mean waiting for [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a date. Stored Markdown, reconcile, and the Tasks registry stay [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly as they are.[/#D7D7AF]
